difficulty_reason: Transfer matrix for a morphism of thickenings: cases (2)(3)(4)(6)(7) by universal homeomorphism invariance of the topological properties; cases (8)(9)(10)(12) via diagonal translation and the thickenings-diagonals lemma; case (11) representability proven by explicit fibre-product decompositions using the thickening lemmas; cases (1)(5) reduced to the algebraic-spaces version via a smooth presentation and the check-on-covering principle.
